title: EnergyEminence: Source-Aware Environmental Calibration and Evaluation in a Physics-Grounded Grid Digital Twin
abstract: arXiv:2609.36215v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Power-grid digital twins must combine data-driven prediction with physically meaningful state evolution while preserving the provenance of environmental observations. This paper presents an early-stage EnergyEminence testbed that couples an IEEE 118-bus-style graph-temporal predictor, nonlinear AC cascade simulation, and operator-dashboard-like temporal replay. In addition, we introduce a shared bounded calibration that converts wildfire-detection confidence and spatial extent into source-comparable wildfire interpretable and explainable evidence. We then evaluate it with visually diverse fire and hard-negative videos. Sixteen synthetic environmental videos are curated to generate 160 source-tracked grid scenarios, and a source-video-disjoint test yields 10 true positives, 8 false positives, 22 true negatives, and no false negatives. translated_title: EnergyEminence：物理接地电网数字孪生中的源感知环境校准与评估
translated_abstract: 电网数字孪生必须将数据驱动的预测与物理上有意义的状态演化相结合，同时保留环境观测的溯源信息。本文提出了一个早期阶段的EnergyEminence测试平台，该平台耦合了IEEE 118母线风格的图-时序预测器、非线性交流级联仿真以及类似操作员仪表盘的时序回放。此外，我们引入了一种共享的有界校准方法，将野火检测置信度和空间范围转换为可跨源比较的、可解释且可说明的野火证据。随后，我们使用视觉上多样化的火灾视频和困难负样本视频对该平台进行评估。我们精心整理了16个合成环境视频，生成了160个源可追踪的电网场景，并在源视频隔离测试中得到10个真阳性、8个假阳性、22个真阴性，且无假阴性。这些错误发生在以未见过的蔓延火源为条件的高压力、非级联场景中。
tldr: 本文提出EnergyEminence测试平台，将图-时序电网预测、非线性交流级联仿真与源感知的野火环境校准相结合，在源视频隔离评估中实现了零漏检（无假阴性）。
en_tdlr: This paper presents EnergyEminence, an early-stage physics-grounded grid digital twin testbed that couples graph-temporal prediction, nonlinear AC cascade simulation, and source-aware wildfire calibration, achieving zero false negatives in a source-video-disjoint evaluation.
